I was in the other day and Nick was Absolutely AMAZING, as usual. He greeted me with the warmest welcome and the Biggest Smile. Nick goes Above and Beyond for a Great Customer Experience. Do not use the same carafe to brew the tea! Coffee is stronger than tea and overpowers the taste. Also, I was going to get a pastry until I saw gnats crawling along the chocolate chip muffin tops. Lots of chicken in the salad and a healthy slice of the avocado ong with everything. I'll visit this location again!!

When I got home the soups were fine, but the grilled cheese wasn't really grilled and the Half grilled Chicken & Avo BLT wasn't grilled either and it had no avocado or bacon. My review in both English and Spanish:

**English:**

Yesterday, my husband and I had the pleasure of dining at Panera Bread, and it was nothing short of amazing. From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming and the service, impeccable. I indulged in the Buffalo Chicken Sandwich paired with the Southern Salad. Every bite was a delightful journey of flavors, and I savored every crumb. My husband opted for the Cream Chicken and Broccoli Soup served on a bun, alongside the Avocado Salad. The soup was a revelation, melting in our mouths with its creamy texture and rich flavors. We also treated ourselves to their lemonade, which was the perfect blend of tangy and sweet, complementing our meal beautifully. Surprisingly, all of this came at a cost of less than $30, leaving us both amazed and satisfied. Panera Bread truly outdid themselves, providing an exceptional dining experience that we can't wait to repeat. If you're looking for quality food at a great value, this is the place to go.

**Spanish:**

Ayer, mi esposo y yo tuvimos el placer de comer en Panera Bread, y fue increíblemente maravilloso. Desde el momento en que entramos, el ambiente fue acogedor y el servicio, impecable. Me deleité con el Sándwich de Pollo Buffalo acompañado de la Ensalada del Sur. Cada bocado fue un delicioso viaje de sabores, y saboreé hasta las últimas migajas. Mi esposo optó por la Sopa de Pollo con Crema y Brócoli servida en un pan, junto con la Ensalada de Aguacate. La sopa fue una revelación, derritiéndose en nuestras bocas con su textura cremosa y ricos sabores. También nos dimos el gusto de probar su limonada, que fue la mezcla perfecta de ácido y dulce, complementando nuestra comida de manera hermosa. Sorprendentemente, todo esto tuvo un costo de menos de $30, dejándonos a ambos asombrados y satisfechos. Panera Bread realmente se superó, proporcionando una experiencia gastronómica excepcional que estamos ansiosos por repetir. Si buscas comida de calidad a un gran valor, este es el lugar a donde ir.

Good service & food was solid

Went in little after 9pm ordered two sandwiches barely any mayo missing advacardo wrong bread not good tasting at all

Good food
Great I love it

CHECK YOUR ORDER BEFORE YOU WALK OUT!  We tried to grab breakfast there two weeks ago. After ordering from their touch screen at the store. Then we ordered again. The time to fill the order took longer than we’re accustomed to. We hustled out late for church because we were there so long. Then in the car found they shorted us one entree that we ordered and paid for. Tried calling them multiple times that day mid afternoon but when I would hit the option to speak with the manager after several rings the phone would just always disconnect, repeatedly. The food was very fair at best what we did receive. Hopefully just one bad customer experience. But, it would be nice of they started their phones. CHECK YOUR ORDER BEFORE YOU WALK OUT! :)
Everything fresh and delicious! They were out of several juices though. Lemonade was completely out! Excellent customer service though!
Meh. Service is just ok. Bathrooms are filthy. Not a good Panera.

Love this place even when it looks like there's a lot of people in there that go really fast
Great atmosphere.   Awesome food and service.
Very disappointed in this location. They need help and some better management!

This visit, they literally had no ingredients, to my order. An many other choices, I would have picked.

An I hadn't been there in well over a year. The food was good, but as always... Over priced!

Third time in a row I’m waiting outside on the curbside for my food and it’s not even busy last time manager gave me the food free I do not want free food I want service curbside please thank you smh!
Food was great and service was fast.

Decided to try this place again and I’m glad that I did. I was unsure what to order so the female employee gave me her recommendation and it turned out GREATTTTT!!! I had the bbq chicken sandwich. The iced coffee was just “ok” for some reason it doesn’t seem as strong as their hot coffee. But it was still pretty decent. But I won’t order it again. I’ll just try a hot coffee or other beverage. I also received their “kitchen sink” cookie and OMG it is so yummy!!! The two female employees that assisted me were excellent. Thank you for a great experience.
Always fresh and on-time
Everyone knows Panera that's why you go there because of the consistency of the product in taste and presentation.
Cinnamon crunch bagels and honey walnut cream cheese is always bomb
Love their healthy eating choices.
Soup was cold
It is a great place to find healthy options
Summer salad  back..yessss

I feel it's over priced it all could be 5-10% less in cost.  It's like food patrons were coving the cost to keep the doors open for those who only wanted to meet and talk with laptops and order water.

Honestly the food is great but as far as ordering online since the pandemic is awful! I suggest if you want to come here do so but don't order online. I have yall actual website and still get door dash that arrives always late! Why dont come here to deliver no more! I work ...this is a mess. Then when my order is wrong yall never pick up the phone someone needs to and everyone else handle the customers. It makes me mad as ever. Then end up eating it cause im working and cant go out to fix it. Im done...im still tryong to call yall its almost 2pm.
I ordered catering from here for the office. They enjoyed it.
The staff was polite and helpful. My broccoli cheddar soup tasted old with a film on top. The men's bathroom was unacceptable, broken stall door, filthy condition overall.

This was my first time visiting with a friend I haven't seen in a long time. The young lady that worked the register this evening was wonderful(Forgive me, I forget her name).

We were there for a long time catching up and she checked on us, had a bubbly personality.

My only gripe is no sweet(non sugar sweetened)treats that's diabetic friendly. I did have a half of salad that didn't seem to make my glycemic load go too high. And it was pretty good. Thanks for the great service at the Northlake.
Good location, fast service, quick curbside pickup.
Good service

I always love going to Panera Bread.  I've never been to one that isn't clean with friendly service.  They're pretty busy during lunch and breakfast so keep that in mind.  This Panera has curbside service which I appreciate.
Nice space, delicious soup but the flat bread pepperoni is a no for me.... It tastes like it sat to long after being warmed up or something.

Slow service.
People are nice.
Seem to be overwhelmed

Great food and meeting place

Love soup sandwich combo

Great
